checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both palms support behind the raised thigh; separate hands without visible overlap.
checks.feet: Opposite leg remains straight with heel on mat; raised knee is straight and toes point toward head.
checks.movement: Lie supine with opposite leg straight, support the raised thigh with both hands, extend raised knee toward ceiling and hold gentle hamstring stretch with head and torso relaxed.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
